title: PS4, PS5 and Xbox One are planned
body: OpenPak has added three more platforms to its catalogue as planned: the PlayStation 4, the PlayStation 5 and the Xbox One (not the Xbox Series S or X). Planned means exactly that: nothing is built, there is no server and no emulator work started, and we will not claim online play for any game. They join the original Xbox, PS2, PSP and PS Vita on the list, behind the consoles that are further along. You can follow the plan on the Titles page, and each platform gets its own post here when it moves.
